shots.prompt: Night over the old city, cold mist rolling over the rooftops
lines: NARRATOR
The seventh night. The last night. And the Archive had gone silent.

shots.prompt: Dark archive aisles, the glass jars grey and silent, cold blue mist on the floor
Elias whispering urgently
lines: ELIAS
He is here. He is silencing the jars, one by one.

shots.prompt: Mira scared but brave
lines: MIRA
If he silences Lumen, I forget my dream forever.

shots.prompt: A tall faceless shadow in a wide hat walks slowly down an archive aisle, glowing jars turning grey where he passes
The tall shadow in the wide hat in the misty dark, face hidden
lines: SHADOW
Quiet dreams cannot hurt anyone. I am only keeping you safe.

shots.prompt: Theo angry and brave
lines: THEO
Safe? You're turning dreams into dust!

shots.prompt: Mira stands firm
lines: MIRA
Dreams aren't supposed to be safe. They're supposed to be ours.

shots.prompt: A silver ribbon of light hovers and hides close to the brass lantern
A gloved shadow hand reaches slowly through the mist
lines: SHADOW
Give me the light, child. Then you will never be sad again.

shots.prompt: Mira holds the lantern close
lines: MIRA
Then I'd never be happy either.

shots.prompt: A small golden music box glows warmly, opening by itself
Elias shouting with hope
lines: ELIAS
Mira, the lullaby! Sing the song your mother sang!

shots.prompt: Mira sings softly, eyes closed
lines: MIRA
Hush now, little star. The night will keep you near.

shots.prompt: A wave of glowing golden musical notes bursts outward, pushing back cold blue frost
The tall shadow steps back, hat tilting, golden light all around
Theo amazed and happy
lines: THEO
It's working! The jars are waking up!

shots.prompt: The shadow fades into the mist
lines: SHADOW
This is not over. Before dawn, the light will be mine.

shots.prompt: Mira breathing hard, determined
lines: MIRA
Before dawn. Then we have until sunrise.

shots.prompt: Elias serious and gentle
lines: ELIAS
And Mira. To keep Lumen, you must remember what you forgot.

shots.prompt: Night, a bright star over the rooftops
lines: NARRATOR
But what had Mira forgotten? And why did it hurt so much to remember?
